scenes.name: hook
scenes.text: You ask an AI chatbot a question, and it writes back like a person. But what's actually happening inside?

scenes.name: tokens
scenes.text: First, your message is split into small pieces called tokens. Whole words, or parts of words, each turned into numbers.

scenes.name: train
scenes.text: The model was trained on a huge amount of text, learning to predict the next token, again and again, billions of times.

scenes.name: network
scenes.text: That learning lives in a neural network with billions of adjustable numbers, called parameters, that capture patterns in language.

scenes.name: next
scenes.text: To reply, it predicts the most likely next token, adds it, then predicts the next one. Word by word.

scenes.name: tune
scenes.text: It's then tuned with human feedback, so its answers become more helpful, and safer.

scenes.name: wrong
scenes.text: It predicts what sounds right, so it can still be confidently wrong. Always double check facts that matter.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.text: Tokens, training, prediction, feedback. Patterns, not magic. Follow for more on how things really work.
